name: Replit Missions
desc: Agent swarms that plan, build and test toward one outcome you define.
desc_zh: 一群智能体朝你定义的一个结果共同规划、构建和测试。
solves: A goal like winning more enterprise customers is too big for one agent run; you state the outcome and budget and the swarm works toward it.
solves_zh: 像多签下企业客户这种目标单次智能体跑不完；你定结果和预算，集群自己去推进。
best_for: You have an outcome to hit and a budget, but no time to break it into tasks.
best_for_zh: 你有一个要达成的目标和一笔预算，却没空拆成任务。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — replit.com/blog; B — Hacker News front page (story 2026-11-18)）。 Page byline: Published: Nov 17, 2026 (Updated: Nov 19, 2026).
